methods.name: MCP regression tools through call_tool_with_session: glmnet JSON, GLS rho, quantreg, OLS aliasing, diagnostics, HAC/DK, smoothers, step, NLS
methods.reference: glmnet::glmnet, glmnet::cv.glmnet, nlme::gls, quantreg::rq/summary.rq, lm, lmtest, sandwich, loess, supsmu, smooth.spline, step, nls (the R cases of each method)
quantities: glmnet coefficient path (lasso, ridge, binomial) and default path lambdas/df; cv coefficients equal the library's; the selection summary precedes the path in the reply
GLS rho, coefficients, SEs, sigma, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC (REML, ML, fixed rho; CS within groups, AR(1))
quantreg coefficients and nid/iid/ker SEs at tau 0.25, 0.5, 0.75; tau/taus refusals
JB, BP, DW, condition number, bgtest F, RESET princomp, Wald F, Harvey-Collier
loess fitted values, supsmu smooths, step criteria, nls estimates and SEs
smooth.spline criterion (library equality, GCV differs from CV)
methods.tolerance: glmnet coefficients 1e-3 absolute at MCP's thresh 1e-7 (an R port of p2a's coordinate descent lies at most 1.7e-4 from the exact minimiser on these fits), deviance ratios 1e-5 absolute, default path lambdas Tol::coef(150), df exact; GLS coefficients Tol::coef(n), SEs Tol::se(n), sigma, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC Tol::stat(n), rho 1e-6 relative; text at the printed precision (Tol::printed: half a unit of the last printed digit); loess Tol::coef(10) / Tol::coef(100), supsmu Tol::coef(100), step Tol::stat(n)

deviations.note: not R-pinned (REG-29, REG-30, Tier 4): the MCP test compares with the library and checks GCV and CV differ
